mechanism: Candesartan may reduce renal clearance of methotrexate by decreasing glomerular filtration rate through angiotensin II receptor blockade, leading to methotrexate accumulation and increased toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function and methotrexate levels; consider alternative antihypertensive if methotrexate dose is high or renal function is compromised; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for MTX toxicity signs.
